budgetCycleStages.title: Stage 1: NEP Proposal (Executive Branch)
budgetCycleStages.summary: The President submits the National Expenditure Program (NEP) to the House of Representatives within 30 days of Congress opening.
budgetCycleStages.details: Prepared by the Department of Budget and Management (DBM). Every agency defends its proposed allocations before congressional committees in televised budget hearings.

budgetCycleStages.title: Stage 2: Legislative Enactment (GAA Law)
budgetCycleStages.summary: The House passes the General Appropriations Bill (HB 10858), the Senate amends it, and the Bicameral Committee reconciles the text.
budgetCycleStages.details: Once signed by the President (with any line-item vetoes), it becomes the General Appropriations Act (GAA) — the official budget law of the Philippines.

budgetCycleStages.title: Stage 3: Allotments & Local Releases (NTA)
budgetCycleStages.summary: DBM issues Special Allotment Release Orders (SARO) and Notices of Cash Allocation (NCA) to agencies, while transferring National Tax Allotments directly to LGUs.
budgetCycleStages.details: For Iriga City, this delivers the ₱913.50M National Tax Allotment directly to the City Treasury, with statutory obligations for 20% development, disaster resilience, youth, and social welfare.

expenseClasses.name: Personnel Services
expenseClasses.summary: Salaries, wages, standard allowances, honoraria, and statutory retirement benefits for civil servants.
expenseClasses.localImpact: Powers teachers, public healthcare workers, city hall staff, and emergency response teams.

expenseClasses.name: Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses
expenseClasses.summary: Supplies, utilities, gasoline, official travel, facility maintenance, communications, and public services.
expenseClasses.localImpact: Keeps municipal offices, ambulances, street lighting, and community programs operational day to day.

expenseClasses.name: Capital Outlays
expenseClasses.summary: Major investments in infrastructure, permanent public assets, roads, bridges, flood controls, and heavy machinery.
expenseClasses.localImpact: Funds public works across Iriga City and Camarines Sur 5th District via DPWH and the Local Development Fund.

expenseClasses.name: Financial Expenses
expenseClasses.summary: Bank service charges, loan interest, insurance management fees, and statutory debt service costs.
expenseClasses.localImpact: Ensures sovereign debt and municipal credit facilities remain fully serviced and in good standing.
